test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Nelson left his home / and went / to the sea / at an early age.
solution:
The correct answer is **'to the sea'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The erroneous part is '**to the sea'.**
 
• In this segment, using the** definite article 'the'** before the **common noun sea **is incorrect. 
 
• **"Go to sea" **is a phrase of** 'sea' **that means **set out on a voyage; become a sailor in a navy or a merchant navy.**
 
• **For Examples:-**
 
 
• The fishermen were unable to** go to sea** in such storms.
 
• Garret left the small family farm in his late teens and **went to sea.**
 
 
 
• To make the sentence correct, we need to eliminate '**the'.**

 

***Correct sentence__ - ****Nelson left his home / and went / **to sea** / at an early age.*
